## Module Boundaries

| Module | Allowed Imports | Forbidden Imports |
|--------|----------------|-------------------|
| api | services, models | ui, cli |
| services | models, utils | api, ui |
| ui | services | models (direct), api |

## Rules

1. No circular dependencies between modules
2. API layer must not contain business logic
3. Services must not import from UI layer
